verdict.rationale: Finix is a payments infrastructure platform. Automation configuration such as subscriptions, payout schedules and webhooks could plausibly be versioned, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence documents versioning, review, or rollback of automations. Webhook logs and webhook creation and updating are adjacent features and do not deliver change history or rollback.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
